privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro_html:
This is a ticketing system, not a CRM. It keeps as little personal data as it can. It stores booking details encrypted.

It does not build customer profiles. To send bookings to a CRM or another tool, add a webhook to a listing. See how to set up a webhook.

To spot returning customers, it keeps a note under a one-way code made from their email or phone. The note holds only the code, not the email or phone itself. Any contact details a listing collects stay with the booking, kept encrypted.
privacy.orphans.heading: Orphaned records
privacy.orphans.intro_html:
When you delete a listing, anyone who booked only that listing is left behind. Their booking details have no listing to attach to. These are orphaned records — data you no longer need.

Delete them below. “Older than” counts from when the booking was made.

privacy.erase.heading: Delete one person's record
privacy.erase.intro_html:
Each returning customer has a note stored under their one-way code. It holds their unsubscribe choice, how many times you have contacted them, and their booking history.

To answer a “right to be forgotten” request under GDPR, delete their note here. Enter the email or phone they booked with.

This does not delete their ticket bookings. Those belong to each listing. Open the Attendees page to delete a booking. Each email and phone is a separate note, so delete each one they gave you.
privacy.erase.identifier_hint: Type it exactly as they gave it to you when booking.

privacy.erase.log_done: Privacy: erased a contact record (GDPR request)
privacy.refunds.heading: Refunds needing attention
privacy.refunds.intro: These refunds stay protected while the site checks what the payment provider did. Open one to see whether the site is still checking or needs your decision.
privacy.refunds.invalid_cursor: This refund page link is invalid. Return to Privacy and open the queue again.
privacy.refunds.reason.possibly_sent: The provider may have received the refund, but the site could not prove what happened.
privacy.refunds.reason.provider_conflict: The provider shows conflicting refund information, so the site cannot safely decide whether money was returned or another refund may be sent.
privacy.refunds.reason.provider_unreadab: The provider could not supply trustworthy payment evidence, so the site cannot safely decide whether a refund should be sent.
privacy.refunds.reason.replay_window_exp: The provider's safe repeat window ended before the site could prove what happened.
privacy.refunds.reason.provider_rejected: The provider rejected the automated recovery. Check the payment there before deciding what the site should do.
privacy.refunds.explanation.send_armed: One exact refund command is ready. The site will not create a second command while this one is outstanding.
privacy.refunds.explanation.observing: The site is checking this refund. It will not send another refund while the outcome is uncertain.
privacy.refunds.explanation.ready: This exact refund has not been sent. Continuing may ask the provider to return the money, so check the reference and amount before sending it.
privacy.refunds.explanation.needs_provid: The provider has not yet proved a complete outcome. Check it again; the site will not send another refund.
privacy.refunds.explanation.completed: The money is known to have been returned, but its matching entry in Money is still due. Record it in Money before closing this work.
privacy.refunds.choice_intro: Check this reference in the payment provider first. The site will not guess what happened.
privacy.refunds.choice_legend: What does the payment provider show?
privacy.refunds.choice_returned: The provider confirms that the money was returned. Record it as returned without sending anything.
privacy.refunds.choice_not_sent: The provider confirms that no refund was sent. Authorize exactly one refund attempt.
privacy.refunds.recorded_legend: Has the returned money been recorded in Money?
privacy.refunds.recorded_choice: I confirm that this returned money is now recorded in Money.
privacy.refunds.error_choice: Choose exactly what the payment provider shows.
privacy.refunds.changed: This refund changed while you were checking it. Read the current details and choose again.
privacy.refunds.unreadable: The provider could not supply trustworthy payment evidence. No refund was sent, and this work remains protected.
privacy.refunds.choice_opened: The provider could not settle what happened. No refund was sent; check the payment there and make the required choice.
privacy.refunds.recheck_needed: The provider still cannot prove that the whole refund finished. No refund was sent; this work remains protected and can be checked again.
privacy.refunds.log_checked: Refund recovery {id}: owner asked the site to check the provider again
privacy.refunds.log_continued: Refund recovery {id}: owner authorized the ready refund to continue
privacy.refunds.log_unreadable: Refund recovery {id}: provider evidence was unreadable; no refund was sent
privacy.refunds.log_choice_opened: Refund recovery {id}: provider evidence opened a required owner choice; no refund was sent
privacy.refunds.log_recheck_needed: Refund recovery {id}: provider evidence still requires another check; no refund was sent
privacy.refunds.log_returned: Refund recovery {id}: owner confirmed that the provider returned the money
privacy.refunds.log_not_sent: Refund recovery {id}: owner confirmed no refund was sent and authorized one attempt
privacy.refunds.log_money_recorded: Refund recovery {id}: owner confirmed the returned money is recorded in Money
